observation.command:
echo "=== FINAL VERIFICATION EVIDENCE ==="
echo "--- 1) All 32 service images present:"
docker images --format '{{.Repository}}' | grep -xvE 'uv:python.*|node.*|python.*|nginx.*|prefect.*' | sort -u | grep -vE '^(ghcr.io|node|python)$' | wc -l
echo "--- 2) Frontend serves shell (HTTP):"
cid=$(docker run -d -p 8189:8080 frontend); sleep 4; curl -s -o /dev/null -w "GET / -> HTTP %{http_code}\n" http://localhost:8189/; docker rm -f $cid >/dev/null
echo "--- 3) demospipes bases import:"
docker run --rm --entrypoint python demospipes-base-api -c "import demospipes_api; print('demospipes_api OK')" 2>&1
docker run --rm --entrypoint python demospipes-base-executors -c "import demospipes_core; print('demospipes_core OK')" 2>&1
